# Execution across brains

Resolve the work owner through company-context/REPOS.md and decision authority
through ORG.md. Verify the destination repository identity, revision and dirty
state, then read its current router, rules and relevant skill. A local path or
familiar repository label is not proof of identity.

Use a narrow read in the current task when sufficient. Use a worker or saved
chat only under the active request and host's dispatch rules. The coordinator
retains scope, dependency, integration and final-verification responsibility.

A handoff carries the objective, exact destination, required sources, allowed
changes, external-action authority, dependencies, acceptance checks and return
shape. Delegation never expands access, publication or mutation authority.

The destination owns its lifecycle. Knowledge work may use main where the
destination permits it; code and protected harness changes use their declared
review path. Keep documented destination exceptions. If a guard or push blocks
the action, report the block rather than bypass it or invent another path.

Job logic remains a skill in its owning brain. The runner launches that skill;
it does not become a new brain or source of domain knowledge. The existing job
registry names its owner, skill, runner/profile, delivery destination, result
evidence and improvement route. Live schedules require their own authority.
